given: After a meeting, a tenant member forwards the notes link to a VP who is not in the meeting and not signed in, via a signed short-TTL meeting-scoped capability token.
when: The VP opens GET /m/{meeting_id} presenting the capability token, then tries the same token against a different meeting_id and against a draft-accept route.
then: The dual-mode read renders notes ONLY (no staged-draft cards) for the valid same-meeting token; the token is refused for the other meeting_id and for any action other than notes:read (draft accept refused) — read-only, meeting-scoped, revocable.
